de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumPurchasing

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumPurchasing>
      • EnumPurchasing
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumPurchasing>

    public enum EnumPurchasing
extends Enum<EnumPurchasing>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Purchasing (A4).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
